title.en: EU opens tender for up to seven AI Gigafactories
title.zhHans: 欧盟启动最多七座 AI Gigafactories 的招标

searchSummary.en: EuroHPC opened a tender to select consortia for up to seven AI Gigafactories, combining planned public support with targeted private investment.
searchSummary.zhHans: EuroHPC 启动招标，拟选出建设最多七座 AI Gigafactories 的联合体，并结合计划中的公共支持与私人投资。

summary.en: The EU opened a call to select consortia for up to seven AI Gigafactories. The plan describes up to €10 billion in EU and national support intended to unlock at least €20 billion in private investment, but it remains a procurement process rather than operating compute capacity.
summary.zhHans: 欧盟启动招标，拟选出建设最多七座 AI Gigafactories 的联合体。该计划描述了欧盟和成员国最高 100 亿欧元支持、旨在撬动至少 200 亿欧元私人投资，但它仍是一项采购流程，而非已经投入运营的算力。

narrative.en: The EuroHPC call asks consortia to establish and operate large AI-compute facilities from which public buyers would procure access time. It moves a previously announced European compute ambition into a competitive selection process and identifies a route for startups, researchers, industry and public authorities to use the resulting infrastructure. Its significance is institutional rather than immediate: bids close in November, projects are yet to be selected, and part of the projected public financing depends on a future EU budget. It should therefore be read as a committed procurement milestone with conditional delivery, not a completed €30 billion build-out.
narrative.zhHans: EuroHPC 的招标要求联合体建设和运营大型 AI 算力设施，公共采购方将从中购买算力使用时间。它把此前宣布的欧洲算力目标推进到竞争性遴选流程，并为初创企业、研究者、产业和公共部门使用未来基础设施明确了一条路径。其意义主要是制度性的，而非即时的：投标在 11 月截止，项目尚未遴选，预计公共融资的一部分还取决于未来的欧盟预算。因此，它应被理解为一个带有交付条件的采购里程碑，而不是已经完成的 300 亿欧元建设项目。

description.en: The procurement creates a prospective public-private investment channel for European AI compute, data-centre services and related infrastructure suppliers.
description.zhHans: 该采购为欧洲 AI 算力、数据中心服务和相关基础设施供应商建立了潜在的公私投资渠道。

description.en: If selected projects are delivered, the procurement model is designed to widen access to advanced compute for startups, research institutions, SMEs and public authorities.
description.zhHans: 若入选项目按计划交付，这一采购模式旨在扩大初创企业、研究机构、中小企业和公共部门对先进算力的访问。

text.en: EuroHPC opened a call to select consortia to establish and operate up to seven AI Gigafactories. The Commission describes up to €10 billion in EU and national support intended to unlock at least €20 billion in private investment.
text.zhHans: EuroHPC 已启动招标，以选出建设和运营最多七座 AI Gigafactories 的联合体。欧盟委员会称，欧盟和成员国最高可提供 100 亿欧元支持，目标是撬动至少 200 亿欧元私人投资。

text.en: The tender creates a concrete public-procurement route for sovereign European AI compute and prospective access for startups, research, industry and public authorities.
text.zhHans: 该招标为欧洲自主 AI 算力及初创企业、研究机构、产业和公共部门的潜在访问建立了具体的公共采购路径。

text.en: The call is not operating capacity or fully committed funding: selection follows the 12 November 2026 deadline, and EuroHPC says part of the public financing depends on the next Multiannual Financial Framework.
text.zhHans: 该招标不等于已经投入运营的算力或全部落实的资金：项目遴选要在 2026 年 11 月 12 日截止后进行，EuroHPC 表示部分公共融资取决于下一期多年期财政框架。
